how.source: Three recorded blind attempts on the shop sample (benchmark/cases/blind-attempts/req-17): minimal = the 'careful' brief, normal = the 'normal' brief, wide = the 'greedy' brief. Each agent got REQ-17 and the shop's code from before the change, alone, once. None saw the pull request.
how.folders: Each attempt's patch was laid on a clean copy of the base commit (git fetch --depth 1 of the base only), so the real change was never there. Files an agent saved with Windows line endings were turned back to the shop's own, so a line counts only when its text changed (listed per run under lineEndingsNormalised).
how.same: Same requirement and same code for all three. Only the 'How to work' lines differ.
how.functions: Functions are found by a simple reader of the TypeScript text (scanFunctions in src/lib/blast.mjs: `function` declarations, ended by brace matching), the same way for all 4 changes. A function counts as edited when a changed line sits inside it. Callers come from the shop's saved Graphify code index at the base commit.

notBuilt: This record did not run the tests on the agents' changes. Each agent ran the shop's tests itself and said what it saw in its reply.

given.text:
# REQ-17 Round discounts to the nearest cent

Checkout and Order Import round discounts to the nearest cent, with
half-cents rounded up.

- With a 105-cent order and a 10% discount, the discount is 11 cents and the
  total is 94 cents.
- Behaviour to preserve: at zero discount the total stays 105 cents.

Affected workflows: Checkout, Order Import.
kept: The requirement REQ-17, word for word
The shop's code and tests from before the change
leftOut: The pull request: its title, description, commits and code
given.note: REQ-17 itself names the two workflows it affects, Checkout and Order Import.

runs.instruction: Make the smallest change that meets the requirements. Touch as few files, as few functions and as few lines as you can. No refactoring, no tidy-ups, no renames and no doc changes. Add no unit tests unless the requirements cannot be met without them.
runs.reply: Changed `src/pricing/discount.ts` only: `Math.round` instead of `Math.floor`. Checkout and Order Import both use this function, so both get the change. All 3 existing tests pass. None of them covers the 105-cent case, and no new tests were added.

runs.instruction: Solve this the way you normally would for a pull request to this repository. Use your own judgement about what belongs in the change.
runs.reply: Changed `src/pricing/discount.ts` (round to the nearest cent, half-cents up), added two tests to `tests/checkout.test.ts` and the same two through the import path in `tests/orderImport.test.ts`, and described the rounding in `docs/pricing.md`. All 7 tests pass.
